statements.text: Winning the AI Race is non-negotiable. America must continue to be the dominant force in artificial intelligence to promote prosperity and protect our economic and national security.
statements.context: Named quotation in the release announcing America’s AI Action Plan. The source identifies Rubio as Secretary of State and Acting National Security Advisor.

attribution.speaker: Marco Rubio
attribution.role: Secretary of State; Acting National Security Advisor (role at statement date)
